description: Colour literals intentionally left in the public JSX files owned by WS7 (contract 10.4 rule 5). The scan test (ws7-js-scan.test.js) fails on any literal in an owned file that is neither here nor a mode-agnostic black shadow (X6).

legend.WS7-A: Intentional dark media/editor chrome that stays dark in both modes (video letterbox and dimmer, orphan or dev-only dark panels, dormant dark-surface sections). Light text on these surfaces would break if the surface followed the theme.
legend.WS7-B: Decorative artwork: brand gradients and shader palettes that are content, not UI chrome (the lava shader ramp and its CSS fallback must stay in step with each other; the headline text-fill gradient is a designer decision recorded in the coverage map).
legend.X2: Content rendered inside an iframe (a separate document with its own background).
legend.X5: Third-party brand marks (Google logo) and fixed brand imagery.
legend.X6: Categorical / data-semantic accent colours that identify an item and must not drift with the theme hue.

pinnedFiles.reason: /looper stays pinned light in v1: the outermost shell carries data-theme-scope="light".
/recreate stays pinned light in v1: the outermost shell carries data-theme-scope="light" and the scene runs in light mode.
/archive stays pinned (its own dark operator console): root main carries data-theme-scope="light".
/post-approval stays pinned: the page main carries data-theme-scope="light".
/preview/* stay pinned light: the shared layout shell carries data-theme-scope="light" and paints the light page.
